root.speaker: creature
root.text: (EXAMPLE DIALOGUE) The thing in the tabard does not rise. "Little bells. Little living bells." Its voice is almost courteous. "I kept the gate. I keep it still. Say why you have come into my house, and say it well."

choices.text: [Diplomacy DC 18] We did not come to rob the dead. We came to ring the bell.
[Intimidate DC 20] Stand aside. The bell will ring tonight.

lore.speaker: creature
lore.text: "Corvin. Warden of this gate. When the fever came I locked the doors and would not let the village in." A dry click, perhaps a laugh. "They were right to fear me. I was already dead by then, I think. I only kept the shape of the office."

pact.speaker: creature
pact.text: The warden is silent for a long moment. "Take the tongue of the bell. Ring it. I will not stop you." He sets something iron on the bier. "When it rings, say the warden's name. Someone should."

effects.text: Corvin yields the crypt without a fight.

choices.text: I will say your name, Corvin.

insult.speaker: creature
insult.text: "You came to ring the bell." The courtesy drains out of the voice. "Then let the bell ring with your bones in it."
